message:
test(rel-0164): the window-procedure isolated test links (the real InputMacro), and the directory tests wait for their server to answer

1. remote60_viewer_window_proc_isolated_test did not link since ka-pc r3 705ed23 (the shipped WndProc stops a running
   macro, viewer_window_proc.cpp:1279-1280): LNK2019 x2 for InputMacro::StopRecording/StopPlayback. The target now
   compiles the real, self-contained input_macro.cpp. Full ALL_BUILD: 0 errors. (Same failure on feat/ka-pc 320bc36.)
2. The directory tests slept a fixed 300-1500 ms after starting server.js, or polled 5-8 s; on a PC where node itself
   takes ~1 s to start, a different test got ECONNREFUSED on each suite run. New test/server_ready.js: GET /healthz
   until 200, bounded at 15 s, noticing an early exit; otherwise "SERVER DID NOT START <label>: <why>" and exit 3
   (a setup failure, never a test result). Used by run.js (nine starts), recovery_fault, device_credential,
   account_admin, observe_contract, proxy_contamination, relay_wire, connect_diag, wake_resend, np_early_bootstrap_e2e;
   relay_env_bound waits for its server's "listening" line the same way. Suite x3: 845 PASS, rc 0 each.

Test build and test scripts only: no product source, no server.js, no payload target changed.
